Short description (160 characters)
kit.value: Brazilian-owned house cleaning in Greer, SC. Deep, move-out, recurring, Airbnb and office cleaning across the Upstate. Free in-home estimates.

kit.label: Long description
kit.value: Perfect Services is a Brazilian-owned cleaning company based in Greer, South Carolina, run by Regiani and Tony. We clean homes, apartments, vacation rentals and offices with a hands-on, detail-first method, including the baseboards, edges and corners a rushed clean skips. Services: recurring house cleaning and maid service, deep cleaning, move-in and move-out cleaning, post-construction cleanup, Airbnb and vacation rental turnovers, apartment and condo cleaning, one-time cleanings, eco-friendly green cleaning and commercial office cleaning. We serve Greer, Taylors, Greenville, Spartanburg, Simpsonville, Mauldin and communities within 30 miles. Free in-home estimates with no commitment: call (864) 399-5168 or text (864) 666-8520.
